name: notify
description: Animated desktop notifications when a session starts, a turn finishes, a tool fails, the context fills up, or Claude asks for permission. Nothing extra to install.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the notifications and /notify. auto follows your system language.

contextWarning.title: Context warning (%)
contextWarning.description: Warn when the context window is this full (and again at 90%). 0 turns the warning off.

permissionButtons.title: Allow / Deny on the popup
permissionButtons.description: On Windows, answer permission prompts from the popup's Allow and Deny buttons. Closing the popup leaves the question to the terminal.
